title: Process Optimization Partner
description:
About the Role


The Process Optimization Partner plays a key role in transforming the People Team’s operations through technology, automation, and intelligent systems. You’ll analyse workflows, identify inefficiencies, and design scalable solutions that enhance the employee and stakeholder experience. This role blends strategic problem-solving with hands-on implementation, leveraging AI tools, process automation, chatbot systems, and dynamic knowledge bases to optimize how the People Team operates.


Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate, document, and improve People Team workflows across the employee lifecycle (recruiting, onboarding, development, engagement, and offboarding).
  • Identify automation opportunities using tools like Zapier, Workato, Power Automate, or internal HRIS systems.
  • Partner with HR stakeholders to reduce manual work, streamline approvals, and improve process accuracy.
  • Implement and monitor AI-driven workflows that enhance response times and reduce operational bottlenecks.
  • Design and maintain AI-powered chatbots to handle routine HR and general support inquiries, FAQs, and employee self-service needs.
  • Continuously analyse chatbot performance to improve accuracy, tone, and efficiency using feedback loops and analytics.
  • Collaborate with IT and data teams to ensure proper integration between HR systems and conversational AI platforms.
  • Build and manage a centralized HR knowledge base that supports employees, managers, and the People Team.
  • Develop structured documentation practices to ensure consistency and ease of information retrieval.
  • Implement taxonomy and tagging systems that enable quick search and smart recommendations.
  • Define and track key metrics related to process efficiency, automation adoption, and employee experience.
  • Use data and feedback to prioritize initiatives and communicate impact to leadership.
  • Stay current on emerging HR technologies, AI trends, and automation best practices.


Qualifications

  • 3–5+ years of experience in HR operations, process improvement, or business automation.
  • Strong understanding of HR workflows, systems, and employee experience design.
  • Hands-on experience with automation platforms (Zapier, Boomi, etc.) and/or AI assistants or chatbot builders (e.g. ChatGPT Enterprise, etc.)
  • Familiarity with HRIS platforms (HiBob, Workday, or similar).
  • Strong project management skills and the ability to translate strategy into execution.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with a collaborative and analytical mindset.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Hubspot CRM.
  • Exposure to AI prompt engineering, knowledge management, or digital transformation initiatives.
  • Passion for creating intuitive, efficient, and employee-friendly systems.


Success in This Role Looks Like

  • The People Team operates with greater speed, accuracy, and consistency.
  • Employees and managers can easily find answers through AI chatbots and a robust knowledge base.
  • Manual, repetitive tasks are reduced or eliminated through automation.
  • Continuous improvement becomes a core capability of the People function.

description:
Somos fanáticos por nossas pessoas! E demonstramos isso oferecendo uma cultura de pertencimento; caminhos claros para o desenvolvimento de carreira; programas de apoio profissional, coaching e mentoria, uma rede global de amigos e colegas que podem te suportar e mais! (Tipo, muito mais.).


Quer estar em uma multinacional que é Great Place to Work, apoiar as melhores marcas do mercado, inovar e mudar o mundo – tudo ao mesmo tempo em que estabelece conexões reais com as pessoas e desenvolve sua carreira?


Seja um #gamechanger Junte-se ao nosso time e vamos tornar isso oficial!

Todas as vagas da Concentrix vagas são elegíveis a Pessoas com Deficiência.


Estamos procurando por um(a) Recruiter I.


O que você fará:


• Responsável por auxiliar na implementação e administração de programas de recrutamento.

• Receber, selecionar e arquivar currículos.

• Conduzir entrevistas de triagem inicial, entrevistas por telefone e/ou entrevistas presenciais com candidatos em potencial.

• Seguir com as ofertas da vaga de acordo com a descrição da conta.

• Acompanhar o candidato desde o processo seletivo até a data de início na empresa.

• Utilizar diversos recursos - internet, organizações comunitárias, mídia impressa, redes formais/informais, faculdades, associações comerciais - para buscar candidatos qualificados, direta e indiretamente.

• Manter padrões consistentes para todos os candidatos e garantir a conformidade com todas as regras e regulamentos locais relacionados à contratação e recrutamento.

• Responsável por desenvolver e aplicar um conhecimento profundo das especificações do cargo, incluindo experiência, habilidades e competências comportamentais necessárias para o sucesso em cada função.

• Promover a imagem da empresa para candidatos e prestadores de serviços externos e garantir que a Empresa é representada da forma mais precisa e apropriada para todos os candidatos e impulsiona pessoalmente os mais altos padrões de comportamento ético para todos os envolvidos nos processos de recrutamento.


Se você possui:


• Um ano de experiência relevante com volumetria;

• Ensino superior cursando ou completo (Administração, Psicologia ou Gestão de Recursos Humanos);

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, tanto escrita quanto verbal;

• Capacidade de realizar múltiplas tarefas, priorizar e cumprir prazos de entrega;

• Proficiência em Microsoft Office;

• Autoiniciativa, senso de urgência, trabalha bem sob pressão, capacidade de trabalhar em ambientes de alta velocidade;

• Senso de profissionalismo e capacidade de desenvolver relacionamentos;

• Grande atenção aos detalhes;

• Capacidade de lidar e manter informações confidenciais.


Aqui é o seu lugar!


O que oferecemos:


• Oportunidade de carreira e desenvolvimento;

• Seguro de vida;

• Plano de Saúde

• Vale-Refeição e/ou Vale-alimentação;

• Vale-transporte;

• Auxílio creche;

• Plataforma online com diversos cursos disponíveis;

• Parceria com diversas Universidades e Escolas de idiomas.

title: UI/UX designer freelancer
description:
Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Criar sites, aplicativos e produtos e serviços em diversos canais;
  • Conduzir atividades de design com a concepção, jornada do usuário, design de interação, arquitetura da informação, design system e prototipação;
  • Garantir a entrega do design, desde a concepção até o lançamento;
  • Apresentar designs, protótipos, visão de experiência e demais tarefas às partes interessadas;
  • Criar design inspiradores, sendo parceiro de um time multifuncional;

  • Conhecimentos no idioma inglês, comunicação verbal e escrita em nível avançado.
  • Disponibilidade para em torno de 2 meses de projeto.

title: SAP Integration Lead (Inglês Avançado)
description:
SAP Integration Lead

We are looking for a consultant able to lead integration processes accross all levels of our client's environment, in contact with stakeholders and also with outside partners.

Together with the leading skills and understanding of the business, the ideal profile would have a strong technical background in SAP SD; SAP ABAP; SAP Order-to-Cash and EDI & Idoc Integration.


Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Provide solution architect leadership & strategy development.
  • Lead Technical architect for medium to large projects.
  • Accountable across multiple functional and technical areas with wide range of complexity.
  • Lead the overall design, including the structure of a segment solution based on requirements from the business, global and regional views, as well as the design of standard software configurations.
  • Building delivery blueprints including but not limited to application diagrams, physical architecture, process diagrams, systems maps, service interfaces, technical interfaces, data modeling, integration planning.
  • Translates non-functional and functional requirement into solution designs, ensuring solution aligns with business goals and processes, uses and provides enterprise information consistently, integrates effectively with other applications, supports a common application environment and user interaction model, uses the common technology platform, and achieves enterprise level security, quality of service and scale.
  • Collaborates with Enterprise Architecture to make sure that the solution fits within enterprise context, while also ensures solutions align with business goals and processes, and follow client's IT Standards and Best Practices.
  • Participates in client's Community of Practice forum with other Solution Architects.
  • Coordinates complex solution architecture implementations while leading design variances based upon business needs. Ensures artifacts are documented.
  • Coordinates engagements with internal and external parties as they relate to evaluation, design and delivery of business capabilities.
  • Contributes to the evaluation and selection of software product standards.
  • Participant in industry representation, policy formation, User Groups, and strategic direction.
  • Provides coaching and leadership to system software developers through enhancements and projects.
  • Works well with varying levels of Business and IT Professionals.
  • Able to communicate technical information in a non-technical manner to Business team (written and verbal).
  • Able to understand business requirements to turn into technical specification solutions.
  • Stay abreast of latest technologies in his/her functional space, consistently growing in knowledge and industry trends.

Candidate Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • 10 years IT professional work experience.
  • Mandatory to have excellent fluency in English; both written and verbal communication skills.
  • Candidate will be regarded as SME and should have high level of expertise in SAP - SD component.
  • Strong ABAP skills, with complex troubleshooting experience.
  • SAP Order-to-Cash end to end expertise required (SD).
  • EDI and Idoc experience highly preferred.
  • Experience in software engineering, software development, solution architecture and able to develop a High Level Design (HLD) and ideally with ability to deliver Low Level Designs within area of expertise.
  • Experience in highly integrated complex data environments e.g. EDI/ BI/ ETL, ERP etc, and open to working in a multitude of SAP and NonSAP applications and technologies.
  • Candidate should possess high level of consultative skills and have prior experience of collaborating with Business Analysts and Enterprise Architects in solving complex business problems with innovative technical solutions.
  • Strong leadership skills
  • Creative thinking
  • Self-motivated and self-starting on work
  • Strong Technical leadership of Application Development teams and vendors.
  • Experience collaborating with Enterprise Architects and infrastructure engineers to identify, design, and implement highly complex, end-to-end solutions.
  • Strong understanding of SDLC processes and methodologies
  • Excellent collaboration skills and can quickly cultivate networking opportunities within the organization at varying levels of Business and IT Professionals.
  • Broad range of business and IT experiences
  • Hold technical and/or business certification(s).
  • Ability to work in a virtual team across distance, with different cultures and time zones, in a matrix with multiple reporting lines, with on-shore and off-shore resources (may extend outside the organization including suppliers, partners and customers).


We are digital changemakers – here to disrupt old ideas, blaze new trails, and help enterprises transform and scale at unparalleled speed.

title: Talent Manager
description:
About the Role


We are looking for an experienced Talent Manager to manage the end-to-end recruitment delivery for customer-side non-technical roles at Turing. You will be responsible for facilitating sourcing candidates, talent planning, capacity management, and internal supply optimization, while activating external sourcing channels where necessary. The ideal candidate has experience in client hiring setups, is highly organized, thrives in dynamic environments, and excels at stakeholder management.


Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the single point of contact between the Internal Delivery and Talent Fulfilment teams for assigned projects.
  • Manage end-to-end fulfilment for multiple client requirements concurrently (typically 3–4 at a time).
  • Conduct talent pool assessments and identify supply-demand gaps.
  • Activate external sourcing channels (via partnerships or talent acquisition teams) when internal supply is insufficient.
  • Oversee resource planning and capacity management, ensuring timely ramp-ups for customer-side roles.
  • Collaborate with Delivery Leads to understand project requirements and talent expectations.
  • Ensure data accuracy and visibility across systems — maintaining reports on hiring pipelines, fulfilment progress, and performance metrics.
  • Track and report fulfilment metrics, including fill rates, turnaround times, and candidate quality.
  • Partner with recruiting and sourcing teams to improve process efficiency and hiring velocity.
  • Deliver a strong stakeholder experience, maintaining proactive communication and alignment on timelines and expectations.
  • Continuously look for opportunities to improve internal talent fulfilment processes and introduce best practices.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 7–12 years of experience in talent operations, recruitment delivery, or resource planning within IT services, outsourcing, or global staffing environments.
  • Proven experience in client-side hiring setups and resource & capacity management.
  • Experience handling multiple simultaneous delivery pipelines and managing cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Working knowledge of LinkedIn Recruiter(good to have) and Google tools (Sheets, Docs, Drive) for tracking and reporting.
  • Data analysis and reporting skills — able to extract insights, identify trends, and drive data-backed decisions.
  • Excellent communication, organization, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently in a remote, fast-paced, and evolving environment.
  • Experience working across global time zones and in cross-cultural teams.


Nice to Have

  • Experience in non-technical recruitment delivery or managing customer-side talent fulfilment.
  • Exposure to capacity planning tools or reporting dashboards.
  • Prior experience in startups or high-growth organizations with minimal structure.
  • Understanding of internal mobility, workforce planning, or project-based staffing models.


Soft Skills

  • Strong stakeholder communication and collaboration skills.
  • Analytical mindset with attention to detail.
  • Adaptability — thrives in ambiguity and rapidly changing environments.
  • Proactive problem solver with a focus on ownership over hierarchy.
  • Comfortable handling multiple priorities and working under tight timelines.


Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a hands-on operator who thrives at the intersection of talent fulfilment, data-driven decision-making, and stakeholder management. They should be proactive, outcome-oriented, and capable of maintaining operational excellence in a remote-first, high-speed environment.

title: Consultor Técnico - P&D
description:
O FI Group busca um profissional para atuar como Consultor (a) Técnico em São Paulo!


O Consultor (a) Técnico irá controlar e acompanhar carteira de clientes, realizando contatos telefônicos, por e-mail e visitas presenciais, analisando a elegibilidade dos projetos, avaliando as características técnicas, riscos, avanços tecnológicos em função de diretrizes, conforme manuais e procedimentos, a fim de classificar os projetos quanto a viabilidade do incentivo fiscal.


Como Consultor (a) Técnico, você irá:

  • Estudar a legislação, casos, serviços e produtos prestados pelo FI Group, através de leitura de guias internos, para obter conhecimento técnico e operacional, dentro dos procedimentos de consultoria, para condução da gestão de empresas categorizadas no mínimo com score C;
  • Efetuar alinhamento para mapear informações técnicas e os dispêndios envolvidos nos projetos, avaliando a tipologia e enquadramento, de acordo com o incentivo fiscal ou programa de fomento trabalhado, a fim de atribuir valor as atividades identificadas e calcular o benefício fiscal ou pleitear recursos para o cliente. De modo a garantir a rastreabilidade necessária perante os incentivos;
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos com foco nas áreas de conhecimento dos projetos, visando defender o conteúdo inovador e o enquadramento das atividades de PD&I na candidatura dos incentivos fiscais ou recursos para inovação Manter as ferramentas de gestão interna atualizadas, em tempo real, com informações referentes ao mapeamento da carteira de clientes, andamento dos produtos trabalhados e demais indicadores operacionais Seguir com analise critica da carteira;
  • Confeccionar e revisar dossiês econômicos, técnicos e finais para sua carteira de clientes, contendo balancetes e seus respectivos comprovativos econômicos, rastreabilidade contábil, relatórios, formulários e demais informações solicitadas pelos órgãos competentes. Assim como prestar suporte operacional e técnico aos outros consultores em todas as etapas do trabalho;
  • Realizar a apresentações junto aos clientes, com finalidades diversificadas, tais como início dos trabalhos, acompanhamento e finalização;
  • Participar de workshop e treinamentos internos para disseminação de conhecimentos e metodologias referentes aos incentivos fiscais e programas de fomento à inovação, e externos para aculturamento a fim de identificar novas oportunidades dos incentivos fiscais e programas de fomento à inovação. Realizar ações de relacionamento, visando fidelização da parceria.


Esperamos que você tenha:

  • Graduação completa em: Engenharia de Produção, Engenharia Mecânica, Engenharia Elétrica e áreas correlatas.
  • CNH ativa para dirigir;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.



Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Cursos e Especializações na área de conhecimento;
  • Espanhol/Inglês;
  • Habilidade em comunicação;
  • Habilidades em escrita (elaboração de relatórios);


O que oferecemos no FI Group:

  • Salário competitivo;
  • Vale Refeição;
  • Vale alimentação;
  • Benefícios Flexíveis;
  • Plano de Saúde;
  • Plano Odontológico;
  • Auxílio Home Office;
  • Modelo de trabalho híbrido;
  • Horário de trabalho flexível;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Gympass;
  • Day off de aniversário;


Muita possibilidade de crescimento! temos muito a crescer e esperamos fortemente que você nos ajude com isso!


“O FI Group valoriza a Diversidade e a Inclusão e por isso incentivamos à candidatura de todas as pessoas para nossas vagas independentemente de gênero, religião, etnia, idade, orientação afetivo sexual, ter deficiência, raça ou outro marcador identitário. Respeitamos as individualidades e trabalhamos para promover uma cultura inclusiva, que busca a equidade e valoriza as diferenças.”


Ficou interessado(a)? Inscreva-se e conheça mais sobre nosso time. #VemSerFI

A Stone nasceu com o propósito de ser protagonista na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, lutando para oferecer as melhores soluções para quem empreende no Brasil.

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

A Stone nasceu com o propósito de ser protagonista na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, lutando para oferecer as melhores soluções para quem empreende no Brasil.

Pensando nisso, construímos a Stone Tech! A junção dos times de tecnologia Stone Co. e as empresas financeiras do grupo que reconhecem o potencial empreendedor de cada brasileiro. Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton, Vitta e Collact, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.


Nossa cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

⚡Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

title: Talent Manager
description:
About the Role


We are looking for an experienced Talent Manager to manage the end-to-end recruitment delivery for customer-side non-technical roles at Turing. You will be responsible for facilitating sourcing candidates, talent planning, capacity management, and internal supply optimization, while activating external sourcing channels where necessary. The ideal candidate has experience in client hiring setups, is highly organized, thrives in dynamic environments, and excels at stakeholder management.


Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the single point of contact between the Internal Delivery and Talent Fulfilment teams for assigned projects.
  • Manage end-to-end fulfilment for multiple client requirements concurrently (typically 3–4 at a time).
  • Conduct talent pool assessments and identify supply-demand gaps.
  • Activate external sourcing channels (via partnerships or talent acquisition teams) when internal supply is insufficient.
  • Oversee resource planning and capacity management, ensuring timely ramp-ups for customer-side roles.
  • Collaborate with Delivery Leads to understand project requirements and talent expectations.
  • Ensure data accuracy and visibility across systems — maintaining reports on hiring pipelines, fulfilment progress, and performance metrics.
  • Track and report fulfilment metrics, including fill rates, turnaround times, and candidate quality.
  • Partner with recruiting and sourcing teams to improve process efficiency and hiring velocity.
  • Deliver a strong stakeholder experience, maintaining proactive communication and alignment on timelines and expectations.
  • Continuously look for opportunities to improve internal talent fulfilment processes and introduce best practices.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 7–12 years of experience in talent operations, recruitment delivery, or resource planning within IT services, outsourcing, or global staffing environments.
  • Proven experience in client-side hiring setups and resource & capacity management.
  • Experience handling multiple simultaneous delivery pipelines and managing cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Working knowledge of LinkedIn Recruiter(good to have) and Google tools (Sheets, Docs, Drive) for tracking and reporting.
  • Data analysis and reporting skills — able to extract insights, identify trends, and drive data-backed decisions.
  • Excellent communication, organization, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently in a remote, fast-paced, and evolving environment.
  • Experience working across global time zones and in cross-cultural teams.


Nice to Have

  • Experience in non-technical recruitment delivery or managing customer-side talent fulfilment.
  • Exposure to capacity planning tools or reporting dashboards.
  • Prior experience in startups or high-growth organizations with minimal structure.
  • Understanding of internal mobility, workforce planning, or project-based staffing models.


Soft Skills

  • Strong stakeholder communication and collaboration skills.
  • Analytical mindset with attention to detail.
  • Adaptability — thrives in ambiguity and rapidly changing environments.
  • Proactive problem solver with a focus on ownership over hierarchy.
  • Comfortable handling multiple priorities and working under tight timelines.


Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a hands-on operator who thrives at the intersection of talent fulfilment, data-driven decision-making, and stakeholder management. They should be proactive, outcome-oriented, and capable of maintaining operational excellence in a remote-first, high-speed environment.

title: UI/UX designer freelancer
description:
Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Criar sites, aplicativos e produtos e serviços em diversos canais;
  • Conduzir atividades de design com a concepção, jornada do usuário, design de interação, arquitetura da informação, design system e prototipação;
  • Garantir a entrega do design, desde a concepção até o lançamento;
  • Apresentar designs, protótipos, visão de experiência e demais tarefas às partes interessadas;
  • Criar design inspiradores, sendo parceiro de um time multifuncional;
  • Gerenciar vários projetos e tarefas variadas;

Requisitos e qualificações

Para essa posição é importante que você tenha:

  • Experiência em design visual, em agência ou ambiente de consultoria;
  • Experiência com design responsivo de e-commerce;
  • Domínio do Figma, e experiência na criação de componentes e na organização de libraries;
  • Conhecimentos no idioma inglês, comunicação verbal e escrita em nível avançado.
  • Disponibilidade para em torno de 2 meses de projeto.

title: SAP Integration Lead (Inglês Avançado)
description:
SAP Integration Lead

We are looking for a consultant able to lead integration processes accross all levels of our client's environment, in contact with stakeholders and also with outside partners.

Together with the leading skills and understanding of the business, the ideal profile would have a strong technical background in SAP SD; SAP ABAP; SAP Order-to-Cash and EDI & Idoc Integration.


Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Provide solution architect leadership & strategy development.
  • Lead Technical architect for medium to large projects.
  • Accountable across multiple functional and technical areas with wide range of complexity.
  • Lead the overall design, including the structure of a segment solution based on requirements from the business, global and regional views, as well as the design of standard software configurations.
  • Building delivery blueprints including but not limited to application diagrams, physical architecture, process diagrams, systems maps, service interfaces, technical interfaces, data modeling, integration planning.
  • Translates non-functional and functional requirement into solution designs, ensuring solution aligns with business goals and processes, uses and provides enterprise information consistently, integrates effectively with other applications, supports a common application environment and user interaction model, uses the common technology platform, and achieves enterprise level security, quality of service and scale.
  • Collaborates with Enterprise Architecture to make sure that the solution fits within enterprise context, while also ensures solutions align with business goals and processes, and follow client's IT Standards and Best Practices.
  • Participates in client's Community of Practice forum with other Solution Architects.
  • Coordinates complex solution architecture implementations while leading design variances based upon business needs. Ensures artifacts are documented.
  • Coordinates engagements with internal and external parties as they relate to evaluation, design and delivery of business capabilities.
  • Contributes to the evaluation and selection of software product standards.
  • Participant in industry representation, policy formation, User Groups, and strategic direction.
  • Provides coaching and leadership to system software developers through enhancements and projects.
  • Works well with varying levels of Business and IT Professionals.
  • Able to communicate technical information in a non-technical manner to Business team (written and verbal).
  • Able to understand business requirements to turn into technical specification solutions.
  • Stay abreast of latest technologies in his/her functional space, consistently growing in knowledge and industry trends.

Candidate Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • 10 years IT professional work experience.
  • Mandatory to have excellent fluency in English; both written and verbal communication skills.
  • Candidate will be regarded as SME and should have high level of expertise in SAP - SD component.
  • Strong ABAP skills, with complex troubleshooting experience.
  • SAP Order-to-Cash end to end expertise required (SD).
  • EDI and Idoc experience highly preferred.
  • Experience in software engineering, software development, solution architecture and able to develop a High Level Design (HLD) and ideally with ability to deliver Low Level Designs within area of expertise.
  • Experience in highly integrated complex data environments e.g. EDI/ BI/ ETL, ERP etc, and open to working in a multitude of SAP and NonSAP applications and technologies.
  • Candidate should possess high level of consultative skills and have prior experience of collaborating with Business Analysts and Enterprise Architects in solving complex business problems with innovative technical solutions.
  • Strong leadership skills
  • Creative thinking
  • Self-motivated and self-starting on work
  • Strong Technical leadership of Application Development teams and vendors.
  • Experience collaborating with Enterprise Architects and infrastructure engineers to identify, design, and implement highly complex, end-to-end solutions.
  • Strong understanding of SDLC processes and methodologies
  • Excellent collaboration skills and can quickly cultivate networking opportunities within the organization at varying levels of Business and IT Professionals.
  • Broad range of business and IT experiences
  • Hold technical and/or business certification(s).
  • Ability to work in a virtual team across distance, with different cultures and time zones, in a matrix with multiple reporting lines, with on-shore and off-shore resources (may extend outside the organization including suppliers, partners and customers).


We are digital changemakers – here to disrupt old ideas, blaze new trails, and help enterprises transform and scale at unparalleled speed.

title: Senior Account Executive (Hunter) — Dados, Governança & IA
description:
Sobre a Apgar

Somos uma consultoria especializada em Data Management, Governança de Dados e Inteligência Artificial , com presença global e reconhecimento do mercado. Atuamos de ponta a ponta — de estratégia e governança até a implementação e operação de soluções de Analytics, MDM, Data Platform e AI — ajudando organizações a transformar dados em valor de negócio sustentável.


Além de serviços, temos ofertas proprietárias e aceleradores (como o ApgarIA para manufatura e supply chain (produção, previsão de demanda, agentes de IA, etc.) — e um portfólio robusto de casos e parcerias tecnológicas que ampliam o impacto nos clientes.


O que Oferecemos:


  • Ambiente global com equipes em 4 continentes
  • Empresa reconhecida internacionalmente, com metodologias próprias, ofertas de AI e stack tecnológica ampla para construir soluções de alto impacto.
  • Somos certificados Great Place to Work no Brasil ,
  • Oferecemos trilhas de formação contínua e coaching de carreira ; cultura colaborativa e meritocrática.
  • Pacote competitivo (salário + variável) e benefícios, com flexibilidade e possibilidade de atuação remota/híbrida.


Local de Trabalho: São Paulo ou Porto Alegre (modelo híbrido/remoto)


Responsabilidades:

Buscamos um(a) hunter nato(a) , apaixonado(a) por Account-Based Selling/Marketing (ABS/ABM) , para abrir novos logos enterprise (médias e grandes contas) que investem em Dados, Governança e IA . Você vai liderar o ciclo comercial completo, da prospecção executiva ao fechamento, orquestrando a proposta de valor da Apgar e conectando-a às dores reais dos clientes.


O que você vai vender


  • Consultoria para programas de Governança de Dados e Estratégia de Dados .
  • Apgar Pathfinder (nossa metodologia para aceleração e priorização de Dados e IA, quick wins/MVP e roadmap integrado entre valor de negócio, fundações de dados e plataforma).
  • Licenças de parceiros líderes de mercado (ex.: Soluções de MDM, Data Catalog, BI, Plataformas de Dados)
  • Serviços de Implementação de soluções MDM , Data Catalog e Plataformas de Dados (ex.: Databricks, Snowflake), além de Analytics & AI .
  • Produtos e Aceleradores Apgar
  • Serviços de Sustentação das soluções implementadas


Principais responsabilidades

  • Hunting com ABS/ABM: mapear contas-alvo, identificar buying centers (C-level, Data Leaders, TI, Operações) e conduzir abordagens multithread.
  • Prospecção executiva: construir relacionamento consultivo, qualificar dores (valor, risco, eficiência), definir hipóteses de valor e próximos passos.
  • Arquitetar a proposta de valor: liderar a coordenação de propostas (escopo, storytelling, casos de uso/ROI, investimento), orquestrando times técnicos para estimativas e demonstrações .
  • Pilotar o funil e forecast: gerir pipeline no CRM, definir e acompanhar plays com o(a) SDR (lista-alvo, mensagens, MQL→SQL), e garantir cadência de reuniões qualificadas.
  • Parcerias: trabalhar com parceiros tecnológicos na conquista de novos negócios.
  • Representar a Apgar em eventos do ecossistema de dados/IA .


Perfil que buscamos

  • Hunter com histórico consistente de abertura de novos logos enterprise em serviços consultoria de dados/IA, governança, MDM ou plataformas de dados.
  • Linguagem de negócio + fluência técnica : fala com CDO/CIO/COO e também debate em bom nível com equipes de dados e governança (sem precisar ser “mão no código”).
  • ABS/ABM practitioner : sabe montar account plans , mapear poder/influência, criar value hypotheses e navegar ciclos complexos.
  • Experiente na Orquestração de propostas ponta a ponta, com ownership da narrativa de valor e da negociação .
  • Networking ativo no ecossistema corporativo de Dados, TI e AI no Brasil/LatAm capaz de gerar pipeline.
  • Comunicação impecável (português) e inglês/espanhol valorizados para LatAm.


Diferenciais que contam pontos

  • Casos vendidos/entregues envolvendo MDM (Customer/Product 360) , Catálogo de Dados, Programas Governança , Databricks/Snowflake , AI/ML .
  • Vivência em metodologias de valor e roadmap (ex.: priorização esforço×impacto, MVP, “from business value to foundations & platform”).
  • Experiência com ApgarIA ou ofertas de AI para Operações (manufatura/supply chain, agentes de IA, otimização).


Como medimos sucesso (primeiros 6–12 meses)

  • Novos logos qualificados e fechados (mid-large/enterprise).
  • Pipeline saudável (cobertura, taxa de conversão, ciclo médio).
  • MVPs/PoVs vendidos com tese de valor clara (Pathfinder → MVP → roll-out).
  • Ativação de parceiros e geração de oportunidades conjuntas.



Apgar Group é um empregador de igualdade de oportunidades e valoriza a diversidade em nossa empresa. Não discriminamos com base em raça, religião, cor, nacionalidade, gênero, orientação sexual, idade, estado civil ou deficiência.

title: PS Systems Engineer
description:
Bradford Jacobs has partnered with an award-winning Technology Solution Provider dedicated to protecting and empowering organizations across the central U.S. They deliver innovative, business-aligned solutions in cybersecurity, cloud, infrastructure, Microsoft, Salesforce, and support services.


As a Systems Engineer, you’ll play a key role in designing, implementing, and supporting complex IT systems for enterprise clients. You’ll work hands-on with modern infrastructure technologies, collaborate with internal engineering teams, and provide expert guidance to help organizations optimize their IT environments.


This role suits a proactive, self-driven engineer who enjoys direct client engagement and thrives in a dynamic, solution-oriented setting.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, install, configure, and support systems technologies, including servers, storage, and Active Directory.
  • Consult with clients on integrating new technologies into existing infrastructures.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to deliver tailored business solutions for critical environments.
  • Manage and resolve client support tickets, maintaining clear communication and documentation.
  • Track time against project agreements to ensure service efficiency and profitability.
  • Report on project progress and participate in ongoing technical training and development.


Skills & Experience

  • 3–4 years of Systems Engineering experience in enterprise or managed service environments.
  • 3–4 years of hands-on experience with Microsoft 365.
  • Strong background in Intune and mobile device management.
  • Proficiency with MFA and/or Single Sign-On solutions.
  • Solid understanding of Windows Server and desktop operating systems.
  • Proven ability to develop and maintain detailed systems documentation.
  • Familiarity with change management, product lifecycles, and client service best practices.


This is a fully remote position, on a B2B contract basis, paying up to USD20 per hour

As a Systems Engineer, you’ll play a key role in designing, implementing, and supporting complex IT systems for enterprise clients. You’ll work hands-on with modern infrastructure technologies, collaborate with internal engineering teams, and provide expert guidance to help organizations optimize their IT environments.


This role suits a proactive, self-driven engineer who enjoys direct client engagement and thrives in a dynamic, solution-oriented setting.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, install, configure, and support systems technologies, including servers, storage, and Active Directory.
  • Consult with clients on integrating new technologies into existing infrastructures.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to deliver tailored business solutions for critical environments.
  • Manage and resolve client support tickets, maintaining clear communication and documentation.
  • Track time against project agreements to ensure service efficiency and profitability.
  • Report on project progress and participate in ongoing technical training and development.


Skills & Experience

  • 3–4 years of Systems Engineering experience in enterprise or managed service environments.
  • 3–4 years of hands-on experience with Microsoft 365.
  • Strong background in Intune and mobile device management.
  • Proficiency with MFA and/or Single Sign-On solutions.
  • Solid understanding of Windows Server and desktop operating systems.
  • Proven ability to develop and maintain detailed systems documentation.
  • Familiarity with change management, product lifecycles, and client service best practices.


This is a fully remote position, on a B2B contract basis, paying up to USD20 per hour

title: Backend Developer  - Pleno
description:
Backend Developer - Pleno


Collaborate with data scientists and ML engineers to understand requirements for ML/LLM features. Design, implement, maintain, improve, and document backend systems (Python, FastAPI) for ML/LLM features. Manage and optimize databases (Postgres, MongoDB, Milvus) for application storage. Improve observability and reliability for distributed, async workloads (structured logging, metrics, retry/backoff strategies, traces). Help maintain and orchestrate containerized development workflows (uv, Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes) and CI checks. Raise the bar for testing (unit + integration) to ensure high code quality and reliability. Improve the local development experience for the team by establishing and promoting Python-based development standards and best practices. Integrate and optimize calls to LLM APIs (OpenAI) and agentic frameworks (OpenAI Agents SDK). Mentor other engineers and drive architectural decisions.


Requirements


  • Experience in backend engineering, specifically in building production services, with over 2 years of expertise in working with asynchronous Python.
  • Extensive Python knowledge: async/await, typing system, modern Pydantic (v2), and testing frameworks (pytest).
  • Production experience building RESTful APIs with FastAPI and ASGI servers (uvicorn).
  • Solid operational and debugging skills for async systems and distributed services.
  • Strong familiarity with Postgres and MongoDB databases.
  • Experience with vector search systems (Milvus, FAISS, Pinecone) and embedding pipelines.
  • Experience with message queues, background processing, and patterns for batch processing, idempotency, and retries.
  • Practical experience integrating with OpenAI or other LLM providers.
  • Comfortable working with containerization technologies (Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with AWS services (EKS, ECS, S3).
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions).
  • Good communication skills and ability to work effectively in a remote team environment.
  • Good English proficiency (reading, writing, speaking).

title: PS Systems Engineer
description:
Bradford Jacobs has partnered with an award-winning Technology Solution Provider dedicated to protecting and empowering organizations across the central U.S. They deliver innovative, business-aligned solutions in cybersecurity, cloud, infrastructure, Microsoft, Salesforce, and support services.


As a Systems Engineer, you’ll play a key role in designing, implementing, and supporting complex IT systems for enterprise clients. You’ll work hands-on with modern infrastructure technologies, collaborate with internal engineering teams, and provide expert guidance to help organizations optimize their IT environments.


This role suits a proactive, self-driven engineer who enjoys direct client engagement and thrives in a dynamic, solution-oriented setting.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, install, configure, and support systems technologies, including servers, storage, and Active Directory.
  • Consult with clients on integrating new technologies into existing infrastructures.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to deliver tailored business solutions for critical environments.
  • Manage and resolve client support tickets, maintaining clear communication and documentation.
  • Track time against project agreements to ensure service efficiency and profitability.
  • Report on project progress and participate in ongoing technical training and development.


Skills & Experience

  • 3–4 years of Systems Engineering experience in enterprise or managed service environments.
  • 3–4 years of hands-on experience with Microsoft 365.
  • Strong background in Intune and mobile device management.
  • Proficiency with MFA and/or Single Sign-On solutions.
  • Solid understanding of Windows Server and desktop operating systems.
  • Proven ability to develop and maintain detailed systems documentation.
  • Familiarity with change management, product lifecycles, and client service best practices.


This is a fully remote position, on a B2B contract basis, paying up to USD20 per hour

Bradford Jacobs has partnered with an award-winning Technology Solution Provider dedicated to protecting and empowering organizations across the central U.S. They deliver innovative, business-aligned solutions in cybersecurity, cloud, infrastructure, Microsoft, Salesforce, and support services.


As a Systems Engineer, you’ll play a key role in designing, implementing, and supporting complex IT systems for enterprise clients. You’ll work hands-on with modern infrastructure technologies, collaborate with internal engineering teams, and provide expert guidance to help organizations optimize their IT environments.


This role suits a proactive, self-driven engineer who enjoys direct client engagement and thrives in a dynamic, solution-oriented setting.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, install, configure, and support systems technologies, including servers, storage, and Active Directory.
  • Consult with clients on integrating new technologies into existing infrastructures.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to deliver tailored business solutions for critical environments.
  • Manage and resolve client support tickets, maintaining clear communication and documentation.
  • Track time against project agreements to ensure service efficiency and profitability.
  • Report on project progress and participate in ongoing technical training and development.


Skills & Experience

  • 3–4 years of Systems Engineering experience in enterprise or managed service environments.
  • 3–4 years of hands-on experience with Microsoft 365.
  • Strong background in Intune and mobile device management.
  • Proficiency with MFA and/or Single Sign-On solutions.
  • Solid understanding of Windows Server and desktop operating systems.
  • Proven ability to develop and maintain detailed systems documentation.
  • Familiarity with change management, product lifecycles, and client service best practices.


This is a fully remote position, on a B2B contract basis, paying up to USD20 per hour

title: Backend Developer  - Pleno
description:
Backend Developer - Pleno


Collaborate with data scientists and ML engineers to understand requirements for ML/LLM features. Design, implement, maintain, improve, and document backend systems (Python, FastAPI) for ML/LLM features. Manage and optimize databases (Postgres, MongoDB, Milvus) for application storage. Improve observability and reliability for distributed, async workloads (structured logging, metrics, retry/backoff strategies, traces). Help maintain and orchestrate containerized development workflows (uv, Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes) and CI checks. Raise the bar for testing (unit + integration) to ensure high code quality and reliability. Improve the local development experience for the team by establishing and promoting Python-based development standards and best practices. Integrate and optimize calls to LLM APIs (OpenAI) and agentic frameworks (OpenAI Agents SDK). Mentor other engineers and drive architectural decisions.


Requirements


  • Experience in backend engineering, specifically in building production services, with over 2 years of expertise in working with asynchronous Python.
  • Extensive Python knowledge: async/await, typing system, modern Pydantic (v2), and testing frameworks (pytest).
  • Production experience building RESTful APIs with FastAPI and ASGI servers (uvicorn).
  • Solid operational and debugging skills for async systems and distributed services.
  • Strong familiarity with Postgres and MongoDB databases.
  • Experience with vector search systems (Milvus, FAISS, Pinecone) and embedding pipelines.
  • Experience with message queues, background processing, and patterns for batch processing, idempotency, and retries.
  • Practical experience integrating with OpenAI or other LLM providers.
  • Comfortable working with containerization technologies (Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with AWS services (EKS, ECS, S3).
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions).
  • Good communication skills and ability to work effectively in a remote team environment.
  • Good English proficiency (reading, writing, speaking).

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
Azure Cloud Application Developer | Remote from Brazil | Fluent English required


Location : Remote – Brazil only

Contract: CLT role


We are looking for an experienced Azure Cloud Application Developer to design, build, and deploy cloud-native applications on Microsoft Azure. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in modern architectures, enjoys working with Java/Spring Boot, and has hands-on experience with AKS and CI/CD environments.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain Java applications using Spring Boot.
  • Architect and deploy cloud-native solutions on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
  • Use Flyway for database versioning and migration management.
  • Build and manage CI/CD pipelines with Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
  • Collaborate with DevOps, QA, and Data teams to deliver end-to-end solutions.
  • Monitor and optimize applications using Splunk and New Relic.
  • Participate in design reviews and architectural decisions.
  • Support analytics and BI initiatives through high-quality data solutions.

Requirements:

  • Proven experience with Microsoft Azure, especially Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
  • Strong proficiency in Java, Spring Boot, and Spring Data JPA
  • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes
  • Hands-on experience with Flyway for database migrations
  • Knowledge of CI/CD tools (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions)
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities
  • Experience with relational or NoSQL databases (Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in agile development environments
  • Knowledge of microservices architecture

description:
O Grupo Quali é líder no segmento de originação de Empréstimo Consignado no Brasil, trazemos inovação, facilidade e benefícios a nossos clientes, em parceria com os principais bancos do segmento.

Somos impulsionados por nossa paixão pela excelência e dedicação incansável aos nossos clientes e colaboradores. "Unidos Para Conquistar o Impossível".


Estamos em busca de Desenvolvedores Python de IA!

Modelo de trabalho: 100% Presencial (Tatuapé/SP)

Contratação PJ com benefícios


Atividades do cargo:

  • Desenvolver e manter chatbots inteligentes integrados a WhatsApp.
  • Projetar, treinar e otimizar modelos de NLP e LLMs para aplicações conversacionais.
  • Integrar soluções de IA com APIs externas, CRMs e bancos de dados.
  • Implementar arquiteturas como RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) para melhorar precisão e relevância das respostas.
  • Garantir a escalabilidade, segurança e performance das soluções de IA.
  • Colaborar com equipes de produto e negócios para transformar necessidades em soluções práticas de automação.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre novas ferramentas, frameworks e avanços em IA Generativa e NLP.
  • Produzir e manter documentação técnica clara.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Python
  • Experiência prática com frameworks de IA (LangChain, LangFuse, CrewAI ou similares).
  • Conhecimento em NLP, embeddings e bancos de dados vetoriais.
  • Experiência em consumo e desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful (FastAPI, Flask, etc.).
  • Experiência com chatbots (WhatsApp Cloud API, Z-API, Gupshup, Twilio).
  • Git, testes automatizados, CI/CD, versionamento de código.
  • Bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais.


Diferenciais

  • Conhecimentos em Machine Learning e Deep Learning aplicados a NLP.
  • Experiência com MLOps e deploy de modelos em produção.
  • Experiência com AWS, Azure ou GCP e serviços de IA/ML.
  • Vivência em fintechs ou setor financeiro.
  • Familiaridade com Docker e Kubernetes.

title: Analista de Automação RPA (Foco em RH)
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional experiente para atuar na identificação, priorização, desenho e desenvolvimento de automações voltadas para processos de Recursos Humanos. Se você é apaixonado(a) por eficiência, tecnologia e otimização de rotinas, essa oportunidade é para você!


Modelo de atuação: Híbrido (2x presencial)

Local: Lorena-SP


Principais Responsabilidades:

Mapear processos de RH e identificar oportunidades de automação que gerem impacto real na operação.

Elaborar, revisar e manter a documentação técnica (PDD e SDD).

Desenvolver, testar, implementar e realizar manutenção em automações utilizando Python (BotCity) e/ou Automation Anywhere.

Apoiar usuários finais durante fases de homologação e atuar na correção de erros ou melhorias em ambiente produtivo.


Requisitos Obrigatórios:

Sólida experiência em RPA, atuando em todo o ciclo: descoberta, desenho, desenvolvimento, testes e suporte.

Domínio de Python para automação (preferencialmente com BotCity) e experiência prática com Automation Anywhere.

Vivência prévia em RH, como analista ou business partner, com entendimento profundo das rotinas e fluxos da área.

Experiência comprovada na elaboração de PDD e SDD.

Sólidos conhecimentos em Git e práticas de desenvolvimento seguro.


Diferenciais:

Certificações em: BotCity Certified Developer e/ou Automation Anywhere Master/Advanced RPA Professional

Experiência com N8N e/ou Pipefy.


Soft Skills Essenciais:

Visão analítica com foco em processos, eficiência e performance.

Excelente comunicação para traduzir demandas de negócio em soluções técnicas.

Proatividade e senso de dono para liderar automações de ponta a ponta.

Organização, disciplina e atenção aos detalhes, tanto em código quanto em documentação.

Capacidade de trabalho colaborativo com equipes de RH, TI e demais stakeholders.


✨ O que oferecemos:


Wellhub (Gympass) – porque a gente acredita que a sua saúde merece mais do que só subir escada quando o elevador quebra.

Assistência médica – pra você ficar bem por dentro e por fora.

title: Analista de integração
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Criar e manter integrações entre sistemas (usando APIs REST).
  • Desenvolver aplicações em .NET (C#).
  • Trabalhar com nuvem Azure (funções, serviços, armazenamento, mensageria, monitoramento).
  • Usar GitHub e pipelines CI/CD para versionamento e automação.
  • Aplicar boas práticas de código (SOLID, Clean Code).
  • Escrever testes automatizados e documentação técnica.
  • Atuar de forma ágil (Scrum, SAFe).


O que você precisa ter:

  • Pelo menos 4 anos de experiência com .NET (C#).
  • Experiência prática com metodologias ágeis.
  • Certificação AZ-104 (Azure Administrator).
  • Azure Functions
  • Azure App Services
  • Azure Key Vault
  • Azure Storage
  • Service Bus
  • Application Insights
  • Git/GitHub e CI/CD (GitHub Actions).
  • Criação e consumo de APIs REST.
  • Segurança com OAuth2 e JWT.
  • Integrações entre diferentes plataformas.
  • Testes automatizados (unitários e de integração).
  • Aplicação de Design Patterns e SOLID.
  • Escrita de código limpo e documentação técnica.
  • Inglês Avançado/Fluente


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Criar e manter integrações entre sistemas (usando APIs REST).
  • Desenvolver aplicações em .NET (C#).
  • Trabalhar com nuvem Azure (funções, serviços, armazenamento, mensageria, monitoramento).
  • Usar GitHub e pipelines CI/CD para versionamento e automação.
  • Aplicar boas práticas de código (SOLID, Clean Code).
  • Escrever testes automatizados e documentação técnica.
  • Atuar de forma ágil (Scrum, SAFe).


O que você precisa ter:

  • Pelo menos 4 anos de experiência com .NET (C#).

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. description:

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Criar e manter integrações entre sistemas (usando APIs REST).
  • Desenvolver aplicações em .NET (C#).
  • Trabalhar com nuvem Azure (funções, serviços, armazenamento, mensageria, monitoramento).
  • Usar GitHub e pipelines CI/CD para versionamento e automação.
  • Aplicar boas práticas de código (SOLID, Clean Code).
  • Escrever testes automatizados e documentação técnica.
  • Atuar de forma ágil (Scrum, SAFe).


O que você precisa ter:

  • Pelo menos 4 anos de experiência com .NET (C#).

  • Azure Functions

title: Recruiter I
description:
Somos fanáticos por nossas pessoas! E demonstramos isso oferecendo uma cultura de pertencimento; caminhos claros para o desenvolvimento de carreira; programas de apoio profissional, coaching e mentoria, uma rede global de amigos e colegas que podem te suportar e mais! (Tipo, muito mais.).


Quer estar em uma multinacional que é Great Place to Work, apoiar as melhores marcas do mercado, inovar e mudar o mundo – tudo ao mesmo tempo em que estabelece conexões reais com as pessoas e desenvolve sua carreira?


Seja um #gamechanger Junte-se ao nosso time e vamos tornar isso oficial!

Todas as vagas da Concentrix vagas são elegíveis a Pessoas com Deficiência.


Estamos procurando por um(a) Recruiter I.


O que você fará:


• Responsável por auxiliar na implementação e administração de programas de recrutamento.

• Receber, selecionar e arquivar currículos.

• Conduzir entrevistas de triagem inicial, entrevistas por telefone e/ou entrevistas presenciais com candidatos em potencial.

• Seguir com as ofertas da vaga de acordo com a descrição da conta.

• Acompanhar o candidato desde o processo seletivo até a data de início na empresa.

• Utilizar diversos recursos - internet, organizações comunitárias, mídia impressa, redes formais/informais, faculdades, associações comerciais - para buscar candidatos qualificados, direta e indiretamente.

• Manter padrões consistentes para todos os candidatos e garantir a conformidade com todas as regras e regulamentos locais relacionados à contratação e recrutamento.

• Responsável por desenvolver e aplicar um conhecimento profundo das especificações do cargo, incluindo experiência, habilidades e competências comportamentais necessárias para o sucesso em cada função.

• Promover a imagem da empresa para candidatos e prestadores de serviços externos e garantir que a Empresa é representada da forma mais precisa e apropriada para todos os candidatos e impulsiona pessoalmente os mais altos padrões de comportamento ético para todos os envolvidos nos processos de recrutamento.


Se você possui:


• Um ano de experiência relevante com volumetria;

• Ensino superior cursando ou completo (Administração, Psicologia ou Gestão de Recursos Humanos);

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, tanto escrita quanto verbal;

• Capacidade de realizar múltiplas tarefas, priorizar e cumprir prazos de entrega;

• Proficiência em Microsoft Office;

• Autoiniciativa, senso de urgência, trabalha bem sob pressão, capacidade de trabalhar em ambientes de alta velocidade;

• Senso de profissionalismo e capacidade de desenvolver relacionamentos;

• Grande atenção aos detalhes;

• Capacidade de lidar e manter informações confidenciais.


Aqui é o seu lugar!


O que oferecemos:


• Oportunidade de carreira e desenvolvimento;

• Seguro de vida;

• Plano de Saúde

• Vale-Refeição e/ou Vale-alimentação;

• Vale-transporte;

• Auxílio creche;

• Plataforma online com diversos cursos disponíveis;

• Parceria com diversas Universidades e Escolas de idiomas.


Local de trabalho: Centro - Curitiba

Horário de trabalho: Seg à Sex das 08h00 às 17:48.

title: Customer Service Analyst
description:
Shape your future as a magentian!


Position: Customer Service Analyst | Export

Job Purpose: Be the focal point for customer attendance, supporting all customer’s requests or direct them to the correct areas.


Main responsibilities and assignments:

  • Entry point between customer, terminals, agents, offshore and destination to ensure requests are correctly handled;
  • Analysis of customers request and instruct correctly about fine risks to all parties involved in process (internal and external);
  • Build solid relationship with your customers portfolio to provide best solution on their case managements;
  • Maintain professional & friendly posture during customer's interaction in daily routine;
  • Work in partnership with the sales representative & sales support;
  • Work as a team to collaborate with the general demand, proposing changes and best practices among others;
  • Guarantee that supervisor is duly aware about any system issue that may impact the customer attendance;
  • Be part of the innovation of the company, contributing with insights and ideas on how we can have better performance


Specific knowledge:

  • Customer Service
  • Intermediate English is mandatory
  • SAP system
  • Working knowledge of International Commercial and Export Chain.


Minimum Required Experience:

  • 3-5 years of experience in a similar role within the shipping industry.


Degree:

  • Bachelor’s degree in international trade or a related field.


Ocean Network Express provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

At Ocean Network Express, we strive toward high-level results for all our employees and pride ourselves on identifying opportunities for internal movement and advancement of proven talent. If you’re interested in a career in the global transportation industry and are looking for growth and advancement opportunities, we encourage you to apply. We enjoy meeting candidates who are persistent in their own professional development.


About Ocean Network Express (ONE)

Ocean Network Express (ONE) was incepted on July 7, 2017, following the liner service integrations of Kawasaki Kisen Kaisha (“K” LINE), Mitsui O.S.K. Lines (MOL) and Nippon Yusen Kaisha (NYK). The new entity functions from its global headquarters in Singapore, supported by regional headquarters in Hong Kong, Singapore, the United Kingdom, the United States, and Brazil. ONE is the world’s seventh-largest container carrier with a fleet size of approximately 1.53 million TEU. Operating more than 200 vessels, it offers an expeditious and reliable international network of over 130 services to 120 countries and beyond. ONE is a member of THE Alliance (THEA), a global ocean carrier consortium.

• Communicate effectively with business stakeholders and development team – adoption of Agile methodology.

title: Automation Anywhere Senior RPA Developer
description:
Practia is present in 7 countries, leading automation and digital transformation projects for major clients. We are one of the most prestigious business and technology companies in Latin America, with a specialized methodology and technical team in automation and Hyperautomation.


We have partnerships and certifications with leading market platforms, acting as a Diamond Partner with UiPath, Platinum Partner with Automation Anywhere, Gold Partner with Microsoft, and Silver Partner with IBM. Our experience and expertise in automation services have earned us, among various awards, the USN (UiPath Service Network) badge and UiPath's LATAM Partner of the Year award.

We are looking for a Senior RPA Developer with expertise in the Automation Anywhere 360 platform to support us in a strategic project alongside a team of analysts and developers.

This person will be involved in the entire RPA development cycle, starting from reviewing the functional documentation, defining development complexity, providing support for solution design and architecture, developing the automation, and supporting testing phases, automation deploy in production and hypercare.

They will be trained in our exclusive development framework and Hyperautomation methodology, SmartBPA®, which spans from Discovery to COE implementation.

As a key contributor to the Intelligent Automation Program , you will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including business analysts, solution architects, and IT professionals, to automate complex business processes while ensuring high-quality, maintainable, and secure automation solutions.


What are we looking for?

  • A person with seniority, experience and expertise in automation development.
  • A person with a consultative and collaborative approach.
  • A person who enjoys working in an environment that fosters competence, transparency, and trust.


Roles and Responsibilities:


  • Degree in Technology, Engineering, or Administration.
  • Experience in automation development with Automation Anywhere platform (Minimum of 5 years).
  • Automation Anywhere 360 Advanced and Master certifications.
  • Design, develop, deploy and sustain end-to-end automation solutions using Automation Anywhere A360.
  • Build and maintain reusable bot components
  • Integrate GenAI/ML, IDP, and APIs into automation workflows for enhanced functionality.
  • Work closely with the Solution Architect to ensure best practices, security, and compliance in automation solutions.


Job Requirements

  • Hands-on experience integrating RPA solutions with APIs, databases, and enterprise applications.
  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, VBScript or JavaScript.
  • Experience in design, develop and debug complex automation workflows and implement robust error-handling mechanisms.
  • Experience in integrating GenAI, ML and IDP into intelligent automation solutions
  • Queue management.
  • Development of standardized documentation (PDD and SDD).
  • Use of frameworks.
  • Experience with Agile methodology, mainly using Scrum and Kanban.
  • Fluent in English.


Knowledge that may be a differential for the position:

  • Knowledge of cloud platforms services like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
  • Knowledge of Automation Anywhere IA Agents, IA Studio, Enterprise Knowledge and Document Automation products.
  • Other certifications and trainings in the intelligent automation field.

We have partnerships and certifications with leading market platforms, acting as a Diamond Partner with UiPath, Platinum Partner with Automation Anywhere, Gold Partner with Microsoft, and Silver Partner with IBM. Our experience and expertise in automation services have earned us, among various awards, the USN (UiPath Service Network) badge and UiPath's LATAM Partner of the Year award.

We are looking for a Senior RPA Developer with expertise in the Automation Anywhere 360 platform to support us in a strategic project alongside a team of analysts and developers.

This person will be involved in the entire RPA development cycle, starting from reviewing the functional documentation, defining development complexity, providing support for solution design and architecture, developing the automation, and supporting testing phases, automation deploy in production and hypercare.

They will be trained in our exclusive development framework and Hyperautomation methodology, SmartBPA®, which spans from Discovery to COE implementation.

As a key contributor to the Intelligent Automation Program , you will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including business analysts, solution architects, and IT professionals, to automate complex business processes while ensuring high-quality, maintainable, and secure automation solutions.


What are we looking for?

  • A person with seniority, experience and expertise in automation development.
  • A person with a consultative and collaborative approach.
  • A person who enjoys working in an environment that fosters competence, transparency, and trust.


Roles and Responsibilities:


  • Degree in Technology, Engineering, or Administration.
  • Experience in automation development with Automation Anywhere platform (Minimum of 5 years).
  • Automation Anywhere 360 Advanced and Master certifications.
  • Design, develop, deploy and sustain end-to-end automation solutions using Automation Anywhere A360.
  • Build and maintain reusable bot components
  • Integrate GenAI/ML, IDP, and APIs into automation workflows for enhanced functionality.
  • Work closely with the Solution Architect to ensure best practices, security, and compliance in automation solutions.


Job Requirements

  • Hands-on experience integrating RPA solutions with APIs, databases, and enterprise applications.
  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, VBScript or JavaScript.
  • Experience in design, develop and debug complex automation workflows and implement robust error-handling mechanisms.
  • Experience in integrating GenAI, ML and IDP into intelligent automation solutions
  • Queue management.
  • Development of standardized documentation (PDD and SDD).
  • Use of frameworks.
  • Experience with Agile methodology, mainly using Scrum and Kanban.
  • Fluent in English.


Knowledge that may be a differential for the position:

  • Knowledge of cloud platforms services like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
  • Knowledge of Automation Anywhere IA Agents, IA Studio, Enterprise Knowledge and Document Automation products.
  • Other certifications and trainings in the intelligent automation field.

We have partnerships and certifications with leading market platforms, acting as a Diamond Partner with UiPath, Platinum Partner with Automation Anywhere, Gold Partner with Microsoft, and Silver Partner with IBM. Our experience and expertise in automation services have earned us, among various awards, the USN (UiPath Service Network) badge and UiPath's LATAM Partner of the Year award.

We are looking for a Senior RPA Developer with expertise in the Automation Anywhere 360 platform to support us in a strategic project alongside a team of analysts and developers.

This person will be involved in the entire RPA development cycle, starting from reviewing the functional documentation, defining development complexity, providing support for solution design and architecture, developing the automation, and supporting testing phases, automation deploy in production and hypercare.

They will be trained in our exclusive development framework and Hyperautomation methodology, SmartBPA®, which spans from Discovery to COE implementation.

As a key contributor to the Intelligent Automation Program , you will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including business analysts, solution architects, and IT professionals, to automate complex business processes while ensuring high-quality, maintainable, and secure automation solutions.


What are we looking for?

  • A person with seniority, experience and expertise in automation development.
  • A person with a consultative and collaborative approach.
  • A person who enjoys working in an environment that fosters competence, transparency, and trust.


Roles and Responsibilities:


  • Degree in Technology, Engineering, or Administration.
  • Experience in automation development with Automation Anywhere platform (Minimum of 5 years).
  • Automation Anywhere 360 Advanced and Master certifications.
  • Design, develop, deploy and sustain end-to-end automation solutions using Automation Anywhere A360.
  • Build and maintain reusable bot components
  • Integrate GenAI/ML, IDP, and APIs into automation workflows for enhanced functionality.
  • Work closely with the Solution Architect to ensure best practices, security, and compliance in automation solutions.


Job Requirements

  • Hands-on experience integrating RPA solutions with APIs, databases, and enterprise applications.
  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, VBScript or JavaScript.
  • Experience in design, develop and debug complex automation workflows and implement robust error-handling mechanisms.
  • Experience in integrating GenAI, ML and IDP into intelligent automation solutions
  • Queue management.
  • Development of standardized documentation (PDD and SDD).
  • Use of frameworks.
  • Experience with Agile methodology, mainly using Scrum and Kanban.
  • Fluent in English.


Knowledge that may be a differential for the position:

  • Knowledge of cloud platforms services like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
  • Knowledge of Automation Anywhere IA Agents, IA Studio, Enterprise Knowledge and Document Automation products.
  • Other certifications and trainings in the intelligent automation field.
